conviction_note: The quarter and a new FY26 guide (adj. EBIT EUR 110-120m, from 120-140m) were pre-released in a profit warning at 13:45 EEST on 20 Oct, inside the session before the window, so the 21 Oct release is a pre-released period with a guide that was set the day before and is not expected to move again. What is left is a one-observation bounce analog (the session after the July warning rose 4.1%) against a guide midpoint that still needs Q4 to improve on the run-rate, leverage near the 3x target with EUR 275m of Silmaasema cash pending, and a selling major holder. These roughly offset, so p_up is 50 and the scaled number is 0; abs_move is set above the 3.1% pre-released base because realised vol has doubled and the release carries an ARC strategy update and the Q3 balance sheet the market has not seen.

already_public.what: Profit warning: FY2026 adj. EBIT guide cut to EUR 110-120m (from 120-140m); Q3 preliminary revenue ~EUR 262.9m (280.4), adj. EBIT ~EUR 17.8m (26.8), 6.8% margin. Q4 demand expected to remain challenging; guide includes Hohde from 4 Sep 2026.

Pre-warning consensus (Inderes & Modular Finance, 5 analysts, 12 Oct 2026): Q3 revenue 269, adj. EBIT 24.0; Inderes FY26 adj. EBIT 129. The pre-release missed adj. EBIT consensus by ~26% and the new guide midpoint (115) sits ~11% under Inderes' FY figure.
Earlier profit warning (15 Jul) cut the guide from 135-165 to 120-140 and pre-released Q2; H1 net debt/adj. EBITDA 2.5x, 9M adj. EBIT now 33.7+26.1+17.8 = 77.6.
Capital markets day moved from December 2026 to spring 2027; Q3 webcast to include a short ARC strategy update and an Oral Health presentation.
Ex-dividend EUR 0.32 on 7 Oct 2026, which explains most of that day's -5.75% close and inflates the sealed 20-day run-up (-18.96%) by ~4 points.

new_in_release.expect: Reiterated at EUR 110-120m one day after being set; a further change is very unlikely. Commentary on Q4 (flu season, occupational-health sales pipeline) is the swing: the midpoint needs Q4 adj. EBIT ~37.4m against 45.0m a year ago (-17%) while Q3 ran -34% y/y.

Q3 operating cash flow and net debt after the Hohde completion are new; with LTM adj. EBITDA falling, leverage is likely near the 3x target before the EUR 275m Silmaasema cash payment. Leans negative, unknown size.
ARC strategy progress update and Oral Health introduction; could include further cost or restructuring action (positive) or nothing new. Sign unknown.
In line with the 20 Oct pre-release; items affecting comparability (Hohde one-offs, Inderes expected ~6m) and segment detail are new but below adj. EBIT.
No change expected; FY25 dividend paid in instalments, last ex-date 7 Oct.

findings.finding: The window opens the session after a same-direction profit warning, after a two-day fall of ~12% (7.09 on 16 Oct to ~6.24 at seal: -5.4% on 19 Oct, which Finnish retail attributes to a Danske downgrade, then -7.4% intraday on 20 Oct on ~1.2m shares). The only in-name analog, the July warning, was followed by +4.13% the next session (7.03 to 7.32) and 0.0% on the report day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: July 2026: warning day 15 Jul -7.38%, next session +4.13%, H1 report day 17 Jul 0.00%, following session -4.64% as estimates were cut (Yahoo daily bars). One observation, and here the bounce session and the report day are the same day.
findings.original_quote: Eilen äkisti -6% ilman näkyvää syytä ja tänään negari. ... Tässä eilisessä liikkeessä oletan, että taustalla oli ainakin osittain Dansken suosituksen downgreidaus. (Inderes forum, 20 Oct 2026: 'Yesterday a sudden -6% with no visible reason and today a profit warning ... I assume yesterday's move was at least partly Danske's recommendation downgrade.')
findings.why_not_priced: It is a claim about how much of the warning the price has already absorbed, not a hidden fact. If the market had fully priced it with no overshoot the stock would sit near the July post-warning level relative to earnings; instead it has fallen 12% for an ~11% cut to the FY EBIT midpoint, more than the -8.4% it took for a ~13% cut in July. Retail flow on the Inderes forum shows dip buying at 6.1. Weak: one analog and an inference.
findings.independence: Inderes forum post 20 Oct 2026 showing retail buying at 6.10: https://forum.inderes.com/t/298/last.json (thread 'ostin-myin-juuri-asken', topic 69575). Not an independent document on direction.

findings.finding: The new guide still needs Q4 to improve on the run-rate: with 9M adj. EBIT at 77.6m (33.7+26.1+17.8), the 110-120m range implies Q4 32.4-42.4m against 45.0m in Q4 2025, so the midpoint needs -17% y/y after Q3's -34%, helped only partly by a full quarter of Hohde, while the company says Q4 demand stays challenging.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide was cut twice in 2026 (15 Jul, 20 Oct), each warning day about -7%; Q3 2025 report fell ~8% on weak demand (Simply Wall St/webull aggregation, not re-verified).
findings.why_not_priced: The guide is public, so this lands inside what the company already guided and is sized near zero. What is not yet in the price is the management tone on Q4 on the call; if the market believed the low end it would be trading as though a third cut were coming, and the -7.4% on the day is about the size of the July reaction, not larger.
findings.independence: Q4 2025 adj. EBIT derived from FY2025 156.3m less Q1-Q3 2025 (47.8+36.7+26.8) in the Q1 and H1 2026 releases: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b7edaeb3902fff63c6b336ba2b5cf9e17&lang=en&src=listed . Same issuer, different documents.

findings.finding: Leverage is near the target ceiling before the biggest deal closes: net debt/adj. EBITDA was 2.5x at H1 (target no more than 3x), Hohde completed on 4 Sep, LTM adj. EBIT is now falling quarter by quarter, and Silmaasema still needs a EUR 275m cash payment, so the Q3 balance sheet in the release is a line the market has not seen.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print where leverage was the surprise; 2.4x (Q1) and 2.5x (H1) passed without a visible reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Q3 net debt has not been published and the warning carried no balance-sheet line. If the market were worried about funding, the bond or a rights-issue rumour would show; neither does. The money buys acquisitions (Hohde, Silmaasema), not distress, so the sign is small and negative only because EBITDA is shrinking under it.

findings.why_not_priced: Whether the selling continues into the report-day bounce is not knowable from the price; a finished seller would remove supply. Inference only, so sized small.

baseline_tension: The sealed lean (+0.95) is the run-up term alone because no short is disclosed; my set is balanced (a bounce analog against guide, leverage and seller risk), so it neither confirms nor fights the lean. The 20-day run-up of -19% overstates the fall by ~4 points because of the 7 Oct ex-dividend.
language_note: Inderes' Finnish Q3 preview (13 Oct) carried the 5-analyst Modular Finance consensus (Q3 adj. EBIT 24.0, revenue 269) and the expectation that the guide would not change; no English source carried the consensus.

The Finnish Inderes forum attributed the unexplained -5.4% on 19 Oct to a Danske downgrade reported on Kauppalehti's news feed, and raised a possible leak before the warning; no English source mentions either. Snippet-level, not a document.
The Finnish forum tallied Rettig's sales from the monthly owner list (about 1.8m shares in September, about 350k in early October), detail the bilingual flagging notice does not give.
The issuer's own releases were bilingual and the English versions carried every figure; the filing itself added nothing in Finnish.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0' and 'the finding lands inside what the company already guided': the implied-Q4 guide finding went from -0.5 to -0.3, since the guide was published the day before.
'A narrow proxy loses to a broad series': the July bounce analog is one observation, so it went from +1.0 to +0.8.
Rettig overhang cut from -0.3 to -0.2: it is an inference that the selling continues inside a one-session window.

'Understatement is the systematic error' and 'the tail is intact': abs_move went from 3.5 to 4.0 (pre-released base 3.1%, 20-day realised vol doubled to 36.6%, and an ARC update plus the unseen Q3 balance sheet are new); p_up stays 50 because a pre-released period with a guide that is not expected to move sits at 45-55.
